An '''individual''' was alive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the individual spoke about the weapons designer [[Goru Rainstealer]] while in a cantina in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="10 Hot Spots">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref>
